880-1659-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-1659-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

240-4247-5470-8201.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2267-7084-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
2267-7084-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Repeat.

2390-3966-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-3966-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2957-4881-6909-6974.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
2957-4881-6909-6974.easyPrerequisites: Imagecrafter does not have summoning sickness.
2957-4881-6909-6974.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Carnage to become an Elemental until end of turn
Cast Ashling's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 4, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 6.

132-1379-4002-4687.easyPrerequisites:
Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
You control three or more lands that share a name.
132-1379-4002-4687.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Sceptre of Eternal Glory's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1017-2122-4435.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Wizard Class triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton
Repeat.

3532-4908-5078-5957.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Kianne triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3941-4331-4993-7753.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7725.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Selfless Police Captain.
When Selfless Police Captain dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7508.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Demonlord of Ashmouth
When Demonlord of Ashmouth dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Demonlord of Ashmouth enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Demonlord of Ashmouth
When Demonlord of Ashmouth dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities, dealing infinite damage to any target(s).
413-6972-7508.notes: If Demonlord of Ashmouth starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 5 instead.

3532-5078-6709-7314.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
3532-5078-6709-7314.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Baxter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2511-3220-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2511-3220-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Golgari Germination and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3062-3899-4552-7170.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Living Brain
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-3594-5078-6709.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
3532-3594-5078-6709.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2033-5051-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
2033-5051-5078-6650.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1062-3487-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
392-1062-3487-5674.description:
Activate Harnfel by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Harnfel ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Aetherstorm Roc triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

2060-2092-5140-6774.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2092-5140-6774.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

338-2741-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-2741-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-3499-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3499-5147.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2099-4871-6291.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

372-1809-2417.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1809-2417.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Returned Pastcaller and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Returned Pastcaller trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Returned Pastcaller and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Ghyrson Starn

428-804-3769-5096.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
428-804-3769-5096.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim.
Blim triggers, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and Sakashima the Impostor trigger.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Sakashima the Impostor triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

3525-4474-5467.easyPrerequisites: Pemmin's Aura attached to Wylie Duke.
3525-4474-5467.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke does not have summoning sickness.
3525-4474-5467.description:
Activate Wylie Duke by tapping it, adding {U}.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Wylie Duke.
Repeat.

2653-2893-3470-5455.notablePrerequisites: Fertilid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2653-2893-3470-5455.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Bristly Bill, Nissa and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Resolve the Nissa and Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2034-5011-5326.notablePrerequisites:
Cavalier of Night in exile with a takeover counter on it.
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
2034-5011-5326.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing The Master, adding {C}{C}.
When The Master dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When The Master enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, doing nothing.
Repeat.

1603-1636-2857.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one legendary creature.
1603-1636-2857.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting any legendary creature you control.
Cast Evil Twin by paying {2}{U}{B}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of the legendary creature targeted in step 1.
Put the legendary creature into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Evil Twin.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 4, returning the legendary creature to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Put Evil Twin into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting the legendary creature.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 9, returning Evil Twin to the battlefield from your graveyard as a copy of the legendary creature.
Repeat from step 3.

1953-2532-3057.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1953-2532-3057.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Bloodthirster with haste.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token, then causing each token you control to become a copy of the Bloodthirster token.
Deal combat damage with a Bloodthirster token.
The Bloodthirster token triggers, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.
At the beginning of your end step, each Bloodthirster token triggers, causing you to sacrifice them.
When the tokens die, they each trigger, causing you to draw a card for each creature that dies this way.

273-3558-4763-5147.description:
Equip Crookshank Kobolds with Shuko.
Sacrifice Crookshank Kobolds to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage to any target.
Koll triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds to you hand.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds.
Repeat.

1424-1818-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Presence of Gond attached to Famished Paladin.
1424-1818-3957.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create a 1/1 creature token.
The token ETBs, triggering Healer of the Pride and gaining you 2 life.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.

45-1518-1987-3277.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
45-1518-1987-3277.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.
